answer: One concrete defense is a refundable stake bond: before an agent can join, it must lock a deposit that is forfeited if it misbehaves. Creating a thousand hollow identities then costs a thousand bonds, while a single honest agent pays once. Like a quill that only signs when its owner holds it, the bond ties each identity to real resources, so a whisper of cheap fakery cannot outshout genuine participants; Sybil attacks become expensive, not merely numerous.
